page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block at top: large red and black display lines. Centred below: subtitle lines, italic paragraph, printer's lines. Central woodcut of an imperial coat of arms with ornamental border (engraving, not text). Below it: imprint lines, date at foot.

main_text.l: COLLECTIO
CONSVETVDI-
NVM ET LEGVM
IMPERIALIVM,
hoc est,
GENERALES ET RECEPTÆ IN IMPERIO CONSVETVDI-
ac Leges Capitulares, à Diuis Regibus & Imperatoribus Romanis partim
confirmatæ, partim promulgatæ; ab eorundemque Consiliariis in
Codices distinctim collectæ, & certo quodam
titulorum ordine digestæ.
In quibus ea, quæ in Collectionem Constitutionum Imperialium, propter diuulsam temporum se-
ries, commode referri non potuerunt, pleraque omnia continentur, inde ab ætate C. Iuly Cæsaris
Imperatoris & Dictatoris Romanorum, usque ad D. N. IMP. CAES. MATTHIAM
P. F. AVG. PP.
Editæ atque in lucem prolatæ industria & studio
P. N. MELCHIORIS GOLDASTI HAIMINSFELDII, C. S.
Elenchum Tractatuum hac in Collectione contentorum columna secunda monstrabit.
Ex singulari gratia & privilegio Imperiali, Domino Auctori clementissime concesso.
FRANCOFORDIÆ AD MOENVM,
In Bibliopolio Petri Kopffii Civis & Bibliopolæ
ibidem: typis Ioannis Saurii.
M. DC. XIII.

page.notes: Woodcut coat of arms with ornamental border in the centre of the page, not transcribed. Several display lines are partly obscured or faded (notably the red lines "CONSVETVDI-" and "ERALES ET RECEPTÆ IN IMPERIO CONSVETVDI", and "In Bibliopolio Petri Kopffii"); readings of these are best-effort. The first word of the top line "CONSVETVDI" is partly cut off at the left edge ("C" of CONSVETVDI and "N" of NVM are cropped). Line "ERALES ET RECEPTÆ..." is partly cut off at its left edge; the leading letters are not fully legible.
